title: The explicit product exchange and compactification coordinates
statement: For compactifications cf of f:X→B and cg of g:Z→B, construct the Cartesian product open i, its square and composite compactification. For a finite commutative ring A, define sectionwise derived open restriction rho, the objects H,F,L0 and the independently specified arrows A0,B0,beta,chi,s,lambda. Define CounitIdentities and Equations as the displayed equality predicates. Define alpha using canonical origin composition and candidate comparisons, compositionRoute using properOpenMate, finiteDirectImageComposition and open composition, and Geometry as the explicit properness, openness, quasi-compactness, Noetherianity and finite-type conjunction. These are exactly the existing product coordinates of lem-pur-product-exchange-counit-coordinates, moved without a change of data or signature. For PurityFiniteSetting the positive quotient coefficient ring is finite.
